parameters.name: CreateTimeEnd
parameters.description: The end of the creation time range. The time must be in UTC and in the ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: CreateTimeStart
parameters.description: The beginning of the creation time range. The time must be in UTC and in the ISO 8601 format.

parameters.name: EndTimeEnd
parameters.description: The end of the end time range. The time must be in UTC and in the ISO 8601 format. For example, 2016-05-23T12:00:00Z.

parameters.name: EndTimeStart
parameters.description: The beginning of the end time range. The time must be in UTC and in the ISO 8601 format. For example, 2016-05-23T12:00:00Z.

parameters.name: InstanceIDs
parameters.description: The instance ID. You can specify up to 100 instance IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,).

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page. The default value is 20. The maximum value is 300.

parameters.name: ProductCode
parameters.description:
The product code. You can call the **QueryProductList** operation to query the product code.

> Required when you specify the Region parameter.

parameters.name: RenewStatus
parameters.description:
The renewal status. Valid values:

- AutoRenewal: auto-renewal

- ManualRenewal: manual renewal

- NotRenewal: no renewal

parameters.name: SubscriptionType
parameters.description:
The subscription type.

- Subscription: subscription

- PayAsYouGo: pay-as-you-go
